data.name: Fungal Ruin
data.description: 1/day, you may target a creature with a destruction spell. A creature slain by this effect crumbles into a mound of russet mold (Bestiary p.273) that immediately releases a cloud of spores in a 20-foot-radius burst. This ability functions as a 9th-level spell.
